item.text:
The QR sign-in issue is localized, but **no project source or tests were changed**. My assigned role in this run permits diagnosis only.

The likely change points are [Settings.tsx](/app/src/settings/Settings.tsx), where the default-disabled experimental setting is missing; [LoginWithQRSection.tsx](/app/src/components/views/settings/devices/LoginWithQRSection.tsx), whose `render()` checks only MSC3882 and MSC3886; and the unconditional section rendering in [SecurityUserSettingsTab.tsx](/app/src/components/views/settings/tabs/user/SecurityUserSettingsTab.tsx) and [SessionManagerTab.tsx](/app/src/components/views/settings/tabs/user/SessionManagerTab.tsx). The latter two files need flag checks, and the section and session manager need `SettingsStore` access.

The existing click handlers already enter `LoginWithQR`, whose flow provides `data-testid="login-with-qr"`; finish callbacks close it. Existing QR tests assume server support alone makes the section visible, so those expectations conflict with the required default-disabled setting. I recorded the diagnosis and test implications in [checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md). Runtime behavior remains unverified.
